projectsData.name: Next.js Personal Portfolio
projectsData.description: This very website — a performant SSR portfolio built with Next.js 15, React 19 and TypeScript. Features an Observatory dark-glass design system, i18n routing (en/es), API-driven content, and animated sections. Deployed on Vercel.

projectsData.name: Chat.io — Real-time Messenger
projectsData.description: A WebSocket-based fullstack messaging app inspired by WhatsApp Web. Built with Node.js, Express, Socket.IO and MongoDB on the backend, and React on the frontend. Supports real-time bi-directional communication between multiple clients.

projectsData.name: URL Shortener
projectsData.description: Full-featured URL shortener with a containerized dev environment using VS Code DevContainers. Built with Next.js and Prisma ORM. Exposes a REST API and includes a ready-to-use UI. Supports custom slugs and click analytics.

projectsData.name: JWT Authentication FullStack
projectsData.description: A complete fullstack example of a secure JWT authentication strategy. Covers all good practices — refresh tokens, httpOnly cookies, token rotation, and access revocation — as well as the most common pitfalls to avoid.

projectsData.name: Codify — Live Code Playground
projectsData.description: An easy-to-use real-time HTML + CSS + JS code playground. Write and run code right in your browser with instant preview. Inspired by CodePen but with a much cleaner, distraction-free UI. Great for sharing snippets and mockups.

projectsData.name: RTC VideoChat — Zoom Clone
projectsData.description: A fullstack Zoom-like video conferencing app using Peer.js (WebRTC) for P2P video, Socket.IO for signaling, and React + Material UI on the frontend. Supports multi-user rooms with real-time peer discovery.

projectsData.name: Python Discord Bot — JULIO
projectsData.description: A custom Discord bot built with the Discord.py async API, originally created for a programming course and later adopted as a teaching tool. JULIO features command handling, fun utilities, and demonstrates async patterns in Python.

projectsData.name: NodeJS + MongoDB + Docker Notes App
projectsData.description: A containerized notes application exploring Docker and docker-compose. Runs a Node.js backend and a MongoDB instance in separate containers orchestrated with Docker Compose. A hands-on reference for container-based local development.

projectsData.name: Vue3 + GraphQL — Rick & Morty UI
projectsData.description: A Vue 3 Composition API app that consumes the Rick and Morty GraphQL API. Built to practice integrating GraphQL into a modern frontend workflow. Features search, filtering and character detail views.

projectsData.name: Book Fetching Curvy Website
projectsData.description: A revamped Node.js book-search backend paired with a visually distinctive frontend using SVG wave shapes generated with haikei.app. Demonstrates creative use of SVG assets to build immersive, scroll-based UIs.

projectsData.name: Advent of Code — Annual Challenges
projectsData.description: Annual attempts at Advent of Code, including the full source code and a written explanation for every challenge solution. Languages vary by year — TypeScript, Python, and Go editions available.

projectsData.name: ASP.NET + MySQL E-Commerce
projectsData.description: A full e-commerce platform built with C# and ASP.NET on the backend backed by a relational MySQL database. Built as the final project for a university development course. Includes product catalog, cart, orders and basic admin panel.
